title: Kanda 7: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 7.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 7.

verses.original: सं जानीध्वं सं पृच्यध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् । संगत्यै वो मनो दधे समेधन्तां धियः शुभाः ॥
verses.transliteration: saṁ jānīdhvaṁ saṁ pṛcyadhvaṁ saṁ vo manāṁsi jānatām | saṁgatyai vo mano dadhe samedhantāṁ dhiyaḥ śubhāḥ ||
verses.translation: Know together, unite together, let your thoughts harmonize in friendship; I direct your minds to mutual concord; may all auspicious thoughts flourish together!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Invocation of fellowship, mutual understanding, and prosperous communal life.

layers.author: whitney
